title: Simple Calculations
code:
# Simple Calculations Example

print("Let's calculate!")
print("1234 + 4321 = ", 1234 + 4321)
print("2 * 3.1415 = ", 2 * 3.1415)
print("5 / 2 = ", 5 / 2)
print("5 // 2 = ", 5 // 2)                
print("5 % 2 = ", 5 % 2)

lines.explanation: This is a comment. It is ignored by the interpreter
This empty line makes the program more readable

This print function has two parameters. One is a string and one is an addition expression (1234+4321). The string is printed as is, the expression is evaluated to 5555 and printed. What you will see printed is 1234 + 4321 =  5555

This print function has two parameters. One is a string and one is a multiplication expression (2 * 3.1415). The string is printed as is, the expression is evaluated  and printed. What you will see printed is 2 * 3.1415 =   6.2830

Single slash in a regular division. The result of evaluating a regular division is always a floating point value, even if it operates with integers. In this case the result is 2.5. What will be printed is 5 / 2 =  2.5

Double slash in an integer division that only can work with two integers. The result of evaluating an integer division is always integer. It ignores the remainder. In this case the result is 2. What will be printed is 5 // 2 =  2

Percent sign indicates the remainder operation that only can work with two integers. The result of evaluating a remainder is also integer. In this case the result is 1. What will be printed is 5 % 2 =  1
